units.source_text: 我同柏木和小姐分手之后，就与房东姑娘一起从事村的山丘下到了北侧，

en.t: After parting from Kashiwagi and the young lady, I went together with the landlady's daughter down from the hill of Kotomura to the north side,

units.source_text: 尔后又往东迁回，爬上了缓坡。

en.t: then turned back eastward and climbed up a gentle slope.
